audit: Independent narrow backend integration audit for lexical variant evidence
scope: Only the new lexical evidence block in server.word and the four-field passthrough/supporting-claim addition in PassageAnalysisService. Unrelated existing changes in these modules are outside this verdict.
checks: The word endpoint obtains lexical evidence from the local accepted index, attaches distinct fields, and does not append lexical variants to morphological or contextual candidate inventories.
Expected index/import/runtime errors yield explicit lexical_variant_status=unavailable and empty lexical fields while preserving source candidates.

Passage analysis deep-copies all four fields and includes supporting claims in claim_applications using their original subjects. Accepted lexical claims have no passage subject and remain general_source_record.
The new code adds no paid provider calls, machine fetch request, contextual ranking request, target-sense resolution, or occurrence-level grammatical assertion.

Independent end-to-end plumbing check used real accepted evidence for τάλαις, ὄππᾳ and δᾶμον in a four-token synthetic transport-only passage with repeated τάλαις. All lexical payloads survived exactly, all supporting-claim scopes stayed general, unresolved crossreference and exact query anchor survived, input payloads stayed unchanged, and repeated-token copies were independent.
A recording machine stub saw only three existing cache reads with fetch=false; the repeated word reused cached lookup and no paid fetch was triggered.
Follow-up helper-only change excludes whole multiline/Greek-contaminated sense previews without altering accepted claims; projection audit refreshed. Server and passage-analysis hashes are unchanged.
limitations: No frontend display behavior or production deployment was examined.
This integration transports general source dictionary evidence. It does not resolve these words morphologically or select a contextual sense.
The LSJ staged subentry database remains separate and was not integrated by this change.
mutations: Auditor wrote only this report; no runtime code, source data or deployment changed.
